//: NO ANALYTICS / NO TELEMETRY — do not add any remote tracking, analytics SDK, or beacon calls here. This extension's core value proposition is zero data collection.
name: Network Sniper
description: DevTools network inspector, editor, and resend client with environment variables and local-first storage.

_permissions_security_justification.storage: Required to persist user collections, request snippets, environments, and ring-buffer history locally on device with zero telemetry.
_permissions_security_justification.optional_host_permissions: Allows on-demand runtime origin permission requests via chrome.permissions.request({ origins: [targetOrigin] }) when a user clicks Resend. Eliminates broad install-time host permissions, resulting in zero scary install-time warnings.
